checks.check: The explicit standard nodal threefold local model and fixed smooth positive probability density are inherited; no arbitrary resolution classification.
Both smooth source measures mu and theta^3 give the codimension-two curves zero mass; the pushforwards have no node atoms.
nu_Y equals pi_*theta^3 by the biholomorphism off the exceptional set; it is finite even if the ambient form is nonclosed.
Off the nodes the positive Radon–Nikodym density satisfies F compose pi=mu/theta^3; its value at nodes is irrelevant.
For r^2=(1+|z|^2)s, the fiber Hessian is h I_2; the base entry s and mixed entries have Schur complement s/h, so determinant h s=r^2.
With ddc=i/(2 pi) partial barpartial, the third wedge divided by 3! is determinant/pi^3 times real six-dimensional Euclidean volume.
A fixed smooth positive ambient form is bounded above and below by Euclidean form on a smaller relatively compact chart; pullback preserves both inequalities.
The source density has positive upper/lower bounds on compact base/fiber charts.
Two bounded compact base charts cover CP1; transformed bundle fiber norms represent the same contracted-coordinate radius r.
The two complex fiber coordinates have real radial factor R^3 dR; z contributes finite two-dimensional base volume.
The weighted p integral has exponent 2-2p+3=5-2p, integrable exactly for p<3.
A fixed nonempty open base subchart and full smaller fiber ball give the required lower bound; not just a finite-chart upper estimate.
p=3 gives R^-1 dR and logarithmic divergence.
nu_Y tube mass is comparable to t^6; F comparable to r^-2 gives both T^-3 bounds for large T.
Outside small node neighborhoods, the smooth positive ratio is bounded, so large-T tails occur only near the finitely many nodes.
With no nodes, the contraction is a global biholomorphism and F is smooth bounded; no nonempty-tail assertion applies.
Normal connected target is unibranch and irreducible; the map is a resolution. The existing appendix descent theorem applies to the arbitrary ambient background.
Descent preserves bounds, suprema and exact background disk tests; no local potential of a nonclosed background is assumed.
Existing resolution-independent extended measure is defined by pushforward; equality extends over the node null set.
Full uniqueness assumes dtheta=0 explicitly, without imposing that condition on the density lemma or general descent paragraph.
The existing cluster limit solves with c0>0, and closed bounded Stokes fixes c0=int theta^3 and the scalar of every other bounded solution.
Positive closed A,B with bounded local potentials lie in the same closed theta class; bounded integration by parts gives the three finite nonnegative energies.
The known smooth cluster limit has A smooth strictly positive off E, so the A^2 energy controls the weak W1,2 gradient on every smaller chart there.
Removing a proper complex analytic subset does not disconnect the connected complex manifold; the zero weak gradient yields one constant off E.
E has ordinary volume zero, so almost-everywhere equality of the two quasi-psh canonical representatives gives global equality.
Equal supremum-zero normalization fixes the additive constant.
Uniform compactness/local smooth estimates and unique cluster limit yield full L1 and smooth local convergence; the unique equation is independent of eta.
The descent bijection and zero exceptional measure give equivalence of bounded equations upstairs and downstairs.
No continuity/Hölder regularity at a node, metric completion, exceptional diameter or GH convergence is asserted; no full formal problem closure.
The sharp local determinant/integrability and energy proof are written directly. EGZ general existence/continuity chain is attribution only and not an imported proof shortcut.
